Turn any website into its own Android app, with ad blocking and userscripts built in.

This is a **beta**, so expect rough edges. Please [report any problems](https://github.com/elsu3ian/scraffold/issues) you find.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **Coming from 1.0.3-beta or older?** Those builds were signed with a temporary key, so this one can't install over them. Export a backup in **Settings**, uninstall Scraffold, install this version, and import the backup. You'll need to sign in to your sites again. This happens only once: from now on, every update installs over the last.

## Highlights

- **A proper media notification:** what's playing, who made it and which app it's in, with its cover, a seek bar, and previous and next (or 10 second jumps).
- **Usage:** Screen time and Battery pages, with a ring for each app's share and a day, week, 14 day, month or year view.
- **Sign in once:** apps and the browser share your sign-ins. Turn on **Separate login** in an app for a second account.
- **Clear cache and Clear data** for each app, from its hold menu.
- **Refresh rate:** ask for 60, 90 or 120 Hz, or Adaptive, on phones that let apps choose.
- **Desktop mode past Cloudflare:** when its "Verify you are human" check turns up, Scraffold offers the site's mobile version, still laid out wide.
- **A stronger ad blocker:** Brave's adblock-rust engine, with Hide an element, undo, your own filters, and a count of what was blocked. It's off until you turn it on.
- **A first-run guide**, update notices, back and forward buttons in the browser, and pull to reload.

## Changes and fixes

- Sites treat Scraffold more like Chrome, so fewer refuse to work or loop on bot checks.
- Pop-ups a site opens by itself are held back until you allow them.
- A black background to start, with Cosmic as a style in the theme settings.
- Scrollbars run along the screen's edge, and Settings and About scroll all the way down.
- Removing a filter, importing a backup's theme, and switching ad blocking now take effect straight away.

## Install

Requires **Android 8.0** or newer.

1. Download `Scraffold-app-release-beta.apk` below.
2. Open it, and allow installs from that source if Android asks.
3. Tap **+** on the shelf to add your first site.

To follow updates from GitHub, add this repository to [Obtainium](https://github.com/ImranR98/Obtainium) with pre-releases turned on.

See the [changelog](https://github.com/elsu3ian/scraffold/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md) for everything in this version.
